purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 812 Palermo (city code 4616); local registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
primaryPublisher: Regione Siciliana SITR; source and attribution Agenzia delle Entrate – Regione Siciliana
registryBasis: Agenzia delle Entrate’s RNDT catalogue has a city-specific vector cadastral dataset “Cartografia catastale - Comune di PALERMO” (revised 2025-01-20). Regione Siciliana SITR publishes regional cadastral cartography with a queryable polygon layer “Particelle”, refreshed July 2026. A safe geometry-only query at the exact WUP point returned one polygon, requesting only service OBJECTID.

officialSources.observation: Agenzia delle Entrate metadata describes the vector cadastral dataset for the specific Comune di Palermo, revised 2025-01-20, with 1:500 scale.

SITR dataset metadata identifies vector cadastral parcels, full Sicily scope, EPSG:3004 metadata, no public access constraint, and CC BY 4.0; data revision metadata 2020-11-01. The serving map layer uses EPSG:25833 and describes a July 2026 update.

Anonymous service metadata lists polygon layer Particelle (layer 4), query formats JSON/geoJSON/PBF, max 1000 records, EPSG:25833, source copyright Agenzia delle Entrate / Regione Siciliana, and a July 2026 update.
Layer schema lists OBJECTID and Shape plus cadastral classification fields. Geometry query was constrained to return only OBJECTID and geometry; all other fields were excluded.

Agenzia delle Entrate publication documents public WMS and WFS cadastral-cartography services. Its published WFS GetCapabilities route returned HTTP 403 anonymously in this inspection; no WFS query followed.

searchQueries.query: Palermo Italy public cadastral parcel polygon GIS vector map official
searchQueries.scope: Find official local registry and anonymous parcel geometry route.
searchQueries.result: Agenzia delle Entrate lists an open WFS for cadastral cartography; the official WFS GetCapabilities request returned HTTP 403 anonymously, so its schema was not inspected. Independently, Regione Siciliana SITR’s official regional ArcGIS service exposes a polygon layer “Particelle” with JSON/GeoJSON query support, native service object ID, and CC BY 4.0 dataset metadata. One exact-point intersection returned one polygon with OBJECTID only.

accessReview.reason: A one-feature local sample is verified, but runtime has not been enabled: citywide completeness, pagination behavior, and a production viewport policy have not been qualified. The national WFS capabilities endpoint returned anonymous HTTP 403; the independently verified regional SITR endpoint supplies the retained sample.

requestEvidence.result: Official anonymous service metadata identified updated July 2026, EPSG:25833, and supported JSON/geoJSON/PBF query formats.
Feature layer Particelle is Polygon; schema includes OBJECTID, Shape and other cadastral classification attributes. A geometry query was constrained to OBJECTID only.
HTTP 200, 751-byte GeoJSON response, one Polygon feature at the queued WUP point; properties contained only OBJECTID=5685467. One closed ring retained in the sample.
HTTP 403, 436-byte response. No credentials, property IDs or feature queries were used.
